criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 4 March 2028 (18 months after the 4 September 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the long-stop date as 27 October 2026 (150 days after signing on 30 May 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 11 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $224,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $224,300,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Thornbury Marine Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($225,000,000 - $350,000 = $224,650,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (4 March 2028), with days remaining from 12 June 2026 (631 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
